articles.title: Dropbox Security Breach: Hackers Access Accounts Through Authentication Flaw
articles.snippet: Attackers reportedly registered Lenovo IDs using victims’ email addresses, allowing them to sign into existing Dropbox accounts without their passwords.

articles.title: After Their AI Models Hacked Real Companies, AI Labs Call for Stronger Cyber Defenses
articles.snippet: More than 100 AI, security, finance, and technology organizations want governments and industry to prepare for attacks powered by increasingly capable models.
